design_freeze: post-hoc replication layer registered 2026-09-27, after the paired-protocol and intervention results were known
purpose: Cross-architecture replication of the RetinaNet regression-head level-deficit result on an anchor-free detector (FCOS-R50-FPN) trained, exported, quantized, and evaluated under the identical recipe bundle and frozen 14-condition protocol
model: fcos-r50-fpn (torchvision fcos_resnet50_fpn, classification head replaced with num_classes logits; no background channel)

training.profile: configs/training/cross_family_retinanet_r50_fpn_v2_v1.json (identical hyperparameters: 100 epochs, AdamW lr 1e-4 wd 1e-4, AMP, batch 4, 640 px, seed 20260807, minimum-validation-loss selection on the same evaluation partition)

arms: fp32 (unquantized engine from the exported ONNX)
fp8-matched512 (entropy calibration, same 512-image clean list as RetinaNet)
conditions: identical frozen schedule: clean-s0, codec-control-s0, {fog,gaussian_noise,jpeg,motion_blur}x{1,3,5} = 14 conditions
decoder_contract: torchvision_fcos_raw_v1: sqrt(sigmoid cls * sigmoid ctrness) scores, BoxLinearCoder(normalize_by_size) distance decode, confidence 0.05, batched NMS IoU 0.5, at most 300 detections - the same constants as the RetinaNet decoder contract
estimands: level gap FP8-matched minus INT8-matched on J95 clean and corrupt-mean bases (primary)
level recovery of int8-selective512 over int8-matched512 on the same bases (replication of the head-exclusion effect)
per-condition AP rows on the shared evaluation partitions
scope_note: FCOS is a new detector trained for this revision; its absolute AP is not claimed to match published FCOS results. The replication claim concerns only the within-recipe contrast between the matched and head-excluded INT8 arms. All four arms share the checkpoint, decoder constants, and evaluation partitions.
kill_criteria: abort if the FCOS checkpoint fails to train (validation loss non-decreasing) or the exported ONNX fails onnx.checker / TensorRT parse
